Learn how to override the invalidation time of the client cache.
content:
{true}).Default: 0 seconds (not cached)The static property is used for statically generated pages, or when the prefetch prop on Link is set to true, or when calling router.prefetch.Default: 5 minutes

Good to know:Loading boundaries are considered reusable for the static period defined in this configuration.This doesn't affect partial rendering, meaning shared layouts won't automatically be refetched on every navigation, only the page segment that changes.This doesn't change back/forward caching behavior to prevent layout shift and to prevent losing the browser scroll position.
